additional_info.subject: ID0370734-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / P3 170000422] Outlet DC2 unavailable CRM:00642001386
additional_info.body:
Hello Team,
We have analyzed the logs for the provided timestamp and found that the charger received an ON feedback from the contactor related to outlet 2 This feedback might be false, for security reasons, it caused the charger to put outlet 2 into an unavailable state.
Upon investigation, it was found that the charger coil is consistently stuck at ON feedback 10 on multiple occasions.
Need to go on site and do troubleshooting check for loose wirings, if needed replace QA09-QA10.
